selection.summary: Issue #1241: first input position must be valid for a match even on first context usage, by starting the window reference at 1 (avoiding problematic index 0). Relevant base evidence: zstd_compress_internal.h window init/update logic (ZSTD_window_init/ZSTD_window_clear at ~617-640, ZSTD_window_update at ~640-719) where dictLimit/lowLimit are seeded at 0/first-block boundaries; ZSTD_window_init and related window helpers (~460-509); and ZSTD_compress.c context reset path (~2000-2079) that seeds the window on first usage. These are the sites where initializing lowLimit/dictLimit to 1 instead of 0 applies.
